description: A SysRq mask chosen rather than defaulted: 48 is sync plus remount read-only, which is what an operations team recovering a wedged physical host actually uses. It is still a failure — 0 is the value to reach for — and it is reported at LOW rather than MEDIUM, because none of what it enables discloses anything or lets an attacker at the console silence logging, dump kernel memory or kill the audit daemon. The same insufficient-effort-versus-total-absence distinction KERNEL-0018 draws, applied to a bitmask.
